title: conflict-aware shared/private Mirror merger
hypothesis: A shared task-delta basis plus selective private exception coordinates preserves task updates and pair compositions at lower bytes than dense deltas, and reveals the private-state threshold as conflict rises.
mirror_coordinate: shared task coefficients plus magnitude-selected private residual entries
controls: shared PCA plus magnitude private residual
random private residual at matched count
native PCA plus top-k residual exact control

development.selection_metric: held-out individual and pair NRMSE, full serialized bytes, residual fraction

fresh.reason: audit not opened if development thresholds fail

success_gate: Both held-out individual and pair NRMSE <=.05, >=25% actual byte savings vs dense, and strictly better quality/byte frontier than matched random residual and native PCA+top-k.
failure_gate: No tested budget meets quality/byte gates or exact native code alias; classify scoped FAIL, audit unopened.
boundaries: Fisher/RegMean statistics and TIES are not implemented; this is a representation frontier screen.
No natural tasks, language quality or production runtime inference.
